import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_12_0 and Source2_12_1 on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source2_12_1.school_name, aggregations = sum(Source2_12_1.reading_score)
# After join, the "school_name" column is from both tables but identical, so we use df_joined["school_name"]
df_grouped = df_joined.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["reading_score"].sum()

# Ensure the target schema: ['school_name': string, 'reading_score': integer]
df_grouped["school_name"] = df_grouped["school_name"].astype(str)
df_grouped["reading_score"] = df_grouped["reading_score"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (common column)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='school_name', right_on='school_name')

# Group by school_name and sum reading_score
result = joined.groupby('school_name', as_index=False)['reading_score'].sum()

# Keep only columns as per target schema
result = result[['school_name', 'reading_score']]

# Write output
